why: Issue #706. The row width becomes its NARROWEST visible button instead of its widest. The row still looks uniform, but every longer label is squeezed into the shortest one's box: Practice (98.4 px) is given Versus's 90 px and wraps or clips. Killed by the widest-sibling case and the observer case, whose utilities row expects Customize's 116 px.
killedBy: menu-row-width.ts: one width per Main Menu row (issue #706) gives every button the widest sibling width, rounded up
menu-row-width.ts: one width per Main Menu row (issue #706) observes every button in every row, re-equalizes on a size change, and stops when disposed
